title: Canonical Offer
description: The one shape every offer must have after ksqlDB, regardless of which carrier or ingestion method it came from. Every connector is validated against this by the shared contract test.

offer_id.description: ADDITIVE FIELD (see docs/decisions.md D-002). Deterministic composite of carrier_key-mode-origin-destination-departureInstantUTC, e.g. 'gigm-road-LOS-ABV-20260914T0600Z'. Stable across refreshes so repeated observations of the SAME physical departure join together - this is what makes GET /offer/{id}, GET /predict?offer_id=, and the price-delta features possible. A readable composite rather than a hash because ksqlDB has no SHA-256 function and a wrong id should be diagnosable by reading it.

carrier.description: Carrier name exactly as it appears in the carrier registry, e.g. GIGM, Air Peace.

mode.description: Transport mode. Drives the door-to-door duration model used by the Fastest ranking.

origin.description: 3-letter place code. IATA where one exists (LOS, ABV, PHC, LHR); internal code where none exists (ONI = Onitsha, road only). See places.py.

destination.description: 3-letter place code, same registry as origin.

depart_time.description: Departure in the ORIGIN's local time with an explicit UTC offset, e.g. 2026-09-14T07:00:00+01:00. Offset-aware always - a naive timestamp is a contract violation. Offset-aware means the instant is unambiguous while the wall-clock time still reads correctly to a traveller.

duration_min.description: Total journey duration in minutes. Capped at 72h to catch unit errors (seconds mistaken for minutes).

price_ngn.description: Total price in Nigerian Naira. ALL sources are converted to NGN at ingestion - GBP fares on the London route are converted using the FX module, never stored in GBP.

seats_left.description: Seats remaining. 0 is valid (sold out). Where a carrier does not publish this, the connector sets it from its documented default and records that in the data-source matrix rather than inventing a number.

booking_url.description: Where the user is sent to complete the booking - a Duffel sandbox reference or a pre-filled carrier deep link.

fetched_at.description: When this observation was collected, in UTC (Z suffix). Drives the staleness flag on /search.
